Literal reading: If you act with understanding and consideration, misfortune will not befall you. Our editorial reading takes the couplet as encouragement to think through a situation and its consequences before proceeding. Its categorical promise gives the advice force; thoughtful action can still meet unforeseen trouble. Exact uploaded ଭଲେ retained without correction. Its precise final-word nuance remains uncertain; the whole clause is translated contextually as misfortune not befalling one, without adding forehead imagery. Odia meaning: ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି କାମ କଲେ ପ୍ରମାଦ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁଛି। ଏହାକୁ ଆମେ କାମର ଅର୍ଥ ଓ ପରିଣାମ ବିଚାର କରି ଆଗେଇବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ବିଚାର କଲେ ସବୁ ବିପଦ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ଭାଲ ଅର୍ଥ କପାଳ ବା ଭାଗ୍ୟ; ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ ଭାଗରେ ବିପଦ ନପଡ଼ିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି। Interpretive reading: Understanding and consideration come before the action. Our editorial reading takes the couplet as encouragement to think through a situation and its consequences before proceeding. Its categorical promise gives the advice force; thoughtful action can still meet unforeseen trouble. Original uploaded final word ଭଲେ is preserved here as evidence; display repairs it to ଭାଲେ using the published counterpart in Namita Paikray’s story at https://odishasambad.in/saradshashi-a-story-for-children-by-namita-paikray-2/ (concluding paragraph, inspected19November2026).
